snapshot: Nikkei 225 night-session futures closed at 65,460 and TOPIX futures at 3,943.5, leaving the Nikkei future about 302 yen above the prior cash close.
The Nikkei opened at 65,247.24, up 89.05, but by 09:20 JST it had already fallen more than 509 points, failing to hold the futures-led premium.
Reuters reported fresh record highs for the S&P 500 and Nasdaq, WTI at $93.89, Brent at $99.58, and the U.S. 10-year yield at 4.493%.
U.S.-Iran peace hopes and chip strength are supportive, but higher Brent, a firmer dollar and Middle East headline risk keep the tape uneven.
The most actionable morning checks are stock-specific: TOB, buybacks, Kioxia-linked names and activist-style large-holder filings.

drivers.driver: U.S. tech strength and higher night-session futures
drivers.why_today: The S&P 500 and Nasdaq hit record highs, while Nikkei 225 futures ended the night session at 65,460. The open was firm, but follow-through quickly became selective.

drivers.driver: Mixed oil signal despite Middle East peace hopes
drivers.why_today: WTI fell but Brent rose. Peace hopes support risk appetite, yet defensive oil-risk positioning remains a constraint into the rest of the session.

drivers.driver: After-close TOB, buybacks and theme catalysts
drivers.why_today: Kodensha's TOB, buybacks at Abalance and Rakumachi, PostPrime's financing and Quest's Kioxia exposure are all easy-to-explain morning materials.

deep_dive.title: Kodensha: an event-driven TOB spread check, not a normal momentum trade

lines: The core catalyst is Kinden's take-private TOB at a clearly defined price of 11,501 yen.
Because the premium is more than 50% over the prior close, the key morning check is how quickly the stock closes the spread.
The tender period starts today, May 26, and runs through July 6.
Kodensha expressed support for the tender offer and recommended that shareholders tender, while also indicating that the stock is expected to be delisted.
Does the stock move cleanly toward the tender price from the buy indication.
Does turnover remain alive as an event stock after the first match.
The spread closes too quickly and leaves little remaining event value.
Investors become cautious about tender conditions or procedural risk.
TOB-event upside becomes mechanically capped as the stock approaches the tender price.
After the stock starts trading, short-term appeal can fade quickly and liquidity may behave differently from ordinary catalyst names.
